d: Watch the match highlights and all goals as Spain beat Fiji 15-0 in Group H of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026, led by five goals from Rafa Cruz, hat-tricks from Roberto Tomas Castell and Guillermo Trujillano, a brace by Jorge Dominguez, and strikes from Marco Company and Yeremaiah Ramos in a record group stage rout at Aspire Zone in Doha.
